newsitem.title: USA: 3-D Geophysical says looking to cut costs.
newsitem.headline: 3-D Geophysical says looking to cut costs.

text.p: 3-D Geophysical Inc said Tuesday it is looking for cost-saving measures, including further consolidation of overhead functions.
The company said those measures are an effort to improve its financial performance.
In the first quarter, which was released Tuesday, 3-D Geophysical reported net income of $938,000, or $0.08 per share, on sales of $24.70 million.
On a pro forma basis, the company reported net income of $821,000, or $0.07 per share, on sales of $14.36 million.
3-D Geophysical provides land-based seismic data acquisition services in the United States, Canada and Mexico.
